title: Strategy and efficiency-redefined discovery of novel nanomolar tyrosinase inhibitors: AI de novo molecular generation + expert-guided structural optimization.
summary: SAC generated an initial tyrosinase lead; synthesis and biological tests confirmed activity, followed by expert-led optimization. Preclinical pigmentation results are not clinical efficacy.
organization: Hangzhou Normal University; Shenyang Pharmaceutical University; Zhejiang Shuren University
